pronunciation.approximation: Say "moirai" with the stress and length implied by the scholarly restoration "Moirai".
pronunciation.note: The ASCII form "moirai" is a DNS compromise; the restoration "Moirai" preserves the name's scholarly dignity.

domains.title: Moirai
domains.subtitle: Fate
domains.lead: Moirai is fate, destiny, thread. The name means "Apportioners (from μείρομαι)" and belongs to the greek tradition.

mythology.lead: The stories of Moirai place fate, destiny, thread at the center of a living mythological world.

myths.title: Origins
myths.text: Moirai appears in greek tradition as fate, destiny, thread. The name's meaning, "Apportioners (from μείρομαι)", shapes the narratives told about this figure.

myths.title: Worship and Memory
myths.text: Devotees and later tradition-keepers preserved Moirai in ritual, text, and iconography, ensuring the name survived into the modern scholarly record.

lore.culturalLegacy: Moirai remains a touchstone for understanding greek religion, art, and identity.
scholarlySources: Hesiod, Theogony and Works and Days.
